tick_origin: Java GameTest tick zero after setting the initial motor RPM.
layout: An X-axis motor drives a Clutch and Gearshift in series with a shaft between and a shaft at the output. Rigs 0 and 1 have the Clutch upstream. Rigs 2 and 3 have the Gearshift upstream.
actions: Two direct redstone placements on tick 3 and two removals on tick 6. Even rigs get the upstream action first. Phase 0 precedes the actions; phases 1 and 2 immediately follow each action on the same tick.
